newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nintendo hopes to sell 4 million game machines end-Dec. [CORRECTED 10:12 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Nintendo hopes to sell 4 million game machines end-Dec. [CORRECTED 10:12 GMT]

text.p: Nintendo Co Ltd said on Tuesday that it hopes to sell two million of its "NINTENDO 64" 64-bit videogame machines by the end of December in Japan, and another two million overseas.
(Corrects headline and first paragraph to make clear four million sales expected)
It hopes to sell a total of six million units by the end of March 1997.
The company earned a total of 4.8 billion yen in foreign exchange profits in the April-September period, Nintendo director Hiroshi Imanishi told a news conference.
Further comments on the company's business and earnings were not immediately available.
Nintendo earlier announced that it posted a parent current profit of 30.01 billion yen in the six months to September 30, 1996, down from 63.87 billion yen in the comparable period.
It also said that it expected a parent current profit of 85 billion in the full year to March 31, 1997, against an actual parent profit of 117.13 billion yen.
